title: A hard drive that weighed over a ton

probes.question: How many disks did the IBM 350 disk system have?
True or false: the IBM 305 RAMAC weighed over a ton.

image.alt: Flat illustration of a stack of disks on a central spindle with an arm reaching in from the side.

body.question: The IBM 350 disk system had fifty 24-inch-diameter disks. About how many characters could it store, in millions?
body.reveal: The IBM 350 disk system stored 5 million alphanumeric characters. The IBM 305 RAMAC, which used it, was publicly announced on September 14, 1956, and weighed over a ton.
